tasks.label: Iniciar Servidor CDR
tasks.command: if (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/CDR-Graf-System-main/backend') { Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}/CDR-Graf-System-main/backend' } elseif (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/backend') { Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}/backend' }; if (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/env/Scripts/python.exe') { & '${workspaceFolder}/env/Scripts/python.exe' run_server.py --host ${input:serverMode} --port ${input:serverPort} --browser ${input:openBrowser} } elseif (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/../env/Scripts/python.exe') { & '${workspaceFolder}/../env/Scripts/python.exe' run_server.py --host ${input:serverMode} --port ${input:serverPort} --browser ${input:openBrowser} } elseif (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/.venv/Scripts/python.exe') { & '${workspaceFolder}/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' run_server.py --host ${input:serverMode} --port ${input:serverPort} --browser ${input:openBrowser} } else { python run_server.py --host ${input:serverMode} --port ${input:serverPort} --browser ${input:openBrowser} }

tasks.label: Iniciar Servidor CDR (Preguntas en Terminal)
tasks.command: if (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/CDR-Graf-System-main/backend') { Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}/CDR-Graf-System-main/backend' } elseif (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/backend') { Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}/backend' }; if (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/env/Scripts/python.exe') { & '${workspaceFolder}/env/Scripts/python.exe' run_server.py --interactive } elseif (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/../env/Scripts/python.exe') { & '${workspaceFolder}/../env/Scripts/python.exe' run_server.py --interactive } elseif (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}/.venv/Scripts/python.exe') { & '${workspaceFolder}/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' run_server.py --interactive } else { python run_server.py --interactive }
